notes.learning: From the existing Yoruba word 'ẹ̀kọ́' (learning/instruction). Extended to cover formal education systems, pedagogy, and curriculum.

examples: Ẹ̀kọ́ jẹ́ ọ̀nà sí ìdàgbàsókè. (Education is the path to development)
Ìjọba ń ṣe àtúnṣe ètò ẹ̀kọ́ orílẹ̀-èdè. (The government is reforming the national education system)
data.subject: Education
